page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre with the year, page number at top right. Signature "F 3" at foot centre, catchword "conce" at foot right.

main_text.l: membra sint necessaria: Multo minus primum ob
eandem rationem concedi poteft, præfertim cum
scriptum illud Episcoporum, ad Synodum sit desti-
natum, ibique prælegendum, quod vel cæcis conspi-
cuum est, fieri non posse, quin prius synodi ipsius
membra constituantur: quibus constitutis, utrum-
que se facturos spondent synodici. At contra utrum-
que tanquam injustum protestatur Deputatus re-
gius: Consensit tamen tandem in Præsidis electio-
nem, protestatione prius præmissa, Electione hac ni-
hil derogatum iuri prærogativæ regiæ, legibus &
consuetudinibus receptis, nec dignitati & authori-
tati Episcoporum, quibus Moderationis honor com-
petit. Respondent Synodici; Sibi nunquam stat-
utum jus regium aut legum vim diminuere; Quod ve-
ro ad Episcopos illos attinet, habendos pro reis quo-
ad de ipsorum innocentia constiterit; Addebant alii
vel eo nomine reos esse, quod prærogativa præsiden-
tiæ per fas & nefas sibi arripuerint. Tandem ad Præ-
sidis electionem ventum est, potioreque suffragiorum
numero eligitur Alexander Hendersonus, pastor
Ecclesiæ Leucherensis in Classe Andreapolitana: Deputa-
tus interim in suffragio ferendo ita se gerebat, quasi
electionem permitteret, ad eamque conniveret po-
tius quam directe ratam haberet. Provinciam eleg-
anti oratione ac ardentibus precibus capessit novus
Præses.
Posthæc Deputatus regius monet, Regem per lite-
ras nominasse sex senatores regni, omnes fere nobi-
les, quibus tanquam suis assessoribus, Ius suffragii de-
finitivi competeret. Responsum à Præside; Regem in
publicis fidei literis à Marchione prolatis, nullam fe-
cisse assessorum quorumlibet mentionem, provinciam
deputationis soli Marchioni commendasse; rem esse
pessimi exempli quæ plurima incommoda secum
traheret, si assessoribus jus illud definitivi suffragii
conce

page.notes: Running head reads "IN REGNO SCOTIÆ." with the year 1638 printed between it and the page number. The catchword "conce" is the start of the next page's first word. Some letters at the left edge are stains or show-through and were not transcribed. Words such as "Præsidis" and "Hendersonus" are clear, but the spelling of the place name "Leucherensis" and the printed "Præfes" are read as printed and not checked against other sources.
